title: Android Developer
summary: An Android developer builds and maintains the Android version of a company's app. They work in a mobile or product team with designers, back-end engineers and testers, and own the app from screen code to Play Store release.
dailyDuties: Build screens in Jetpack Compose using Kotlin and coroutines
Call back-end APIs with Retrofit and handle errors and offline states
Structure features with ViewModel and an architecture such as MVVM
Write unit tests for view models
Maintain and fix older Java code
Raise pull requests and review teammates' code
Prepare and roll out releases on the Play Store

skills.expectation: Build screens with Jetpack Compose and handle the app lifecycle
Call APIs with Retrofit and handle errors and offline states
Use ViewModel and a clear architecture such as MVVM
Work with branches and pull requests
Publish and roll out a release on the Play Store
Write unit tests for view models
